en: Colorized winter view of a steep funicular railway climbing up a snow-covered hill toward a tunnel under a large building complex. The scene shows tracks of the Schlossbergbahn in the snow, a carriage with a driver ascending on the right, iron railings in the foreground, and the Café-Restaurant Schlossberg buildings above the tunnel. Printed caption text appears at the top in German.
